title_protection.quote: A person shall not advertise in any form or hold himself or herself out to the public as a podiatrist, or, in any sign or any advertisement, use the word "podiatrist", "foot specialist", "foot correctionist", "foot expert", "practipedist", "podologist", or any other terms or letters indicating or implying that the person is a podiatrist or that the person practices or holds himself or herself out as practicing podiatry or foot correction in any manner, without having, at the time of so doing, a valid, unsuspended, and unrevoked license as required by this article 290.

scope_protection.quote: Any person who practices or offers or attempts to practice podiatry within this state without an active license issued under this article 290 is subject to penalties pursuant to section 12-20-407 (1)(a).

disciplinary_grounds.description: Resorting to fraud, misrepresentation, or material deception in applying for, securing, renewing, or seeking reinstatement of a license or in taking the required examination.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Resorting to fraud, misrepresentation, or material deception, or making a misleading omission, in applying for, securing, renewing, or seeking reinstatement of a license to practice podiatry in this state or any other state

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony or any crime that would constitute a violation of the podiatry practice act.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a felony or any crime that would constitute a violation of this article 290.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitual or excessive use or abuse of alcohol or controlled substances.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Habitual or excessive use or abuse of alcohol or controlled substances

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding or abetting in the practice of podiatry any unlicensed person or a person whose license is suspended.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding or abetting in the practice of podiatry any person not licensed to practice podiatry or any person whose license to practice podiatry is suspended

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any act or omission that fails to meet generally accepted standards of the practice of podiatry.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any act or omission that fails to meet generally accepted standards of the practice of podiatry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing podiatry as a partner, agent, or employee with unlicensed persons or non-professional corporations, with exceptions.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Except as otherwise provided in section 25-3-103.7, practicing podiatry as: The partner, agent, or employee of, or in joint venture with, any person who does not hold a license to practice podiatry within this state

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating, attempting to violate, or conspiring to violate any provision of the podiatry practice act or board rules.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating, or attempting to violate, directly or indirectly, or assisting in or abetting the violation of, or conspiring to violate any provision or term of this article 290

disciplinary_grounds.description: Administering, dispensing, or prescribing habit-forming drugs or controlled substances outside the course of legitimate professional practice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Administering, dispensing, or prescribing any habit-forming drug or any controlled substance, as defined in section 18-18-102 (5), other than in the course of legitimate professional practice, which includes only prescriptions related to the scope of podiatric medicine

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of violation of any federal or state law regulating controlled substances.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to notify the board of a physical illness, condition, or behavioral/mental health disorder affecting ability to practice safely.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to: Notify the board of a physical illness, physical condition, or behavioral or mental health disorder that affects the podiatrist's ability to practice podiatric medicine with reasonable skill and safety to patients

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising that is misleading, deceptive, or false.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advertising that is misleading, deceptive, or false

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation or abuse of health insurance.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation or abuse of health insurance pursuant to section 18-13-119

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in a sexual act with a patient during the course of patient care or within six months after termination of care.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in a sexual act with a patient during the course of patient care or during the six-month period immediately following the termination of such care.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing any procedure beyond the podiatrist's training and competence.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing any procedure in the course of patient care beyond the podiatrist's training and competence.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful and repeated ordering or performance of demonstrably unnecessary services or treatments without clinical justification.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willful and repeated ordering or performance, without clinical justification, of demonstrably unnecessary laboratory tests or studies; the administration, without clinical justification, of treatment that is demonstrably unnecessary

disciplinary_grounds.description: Falsifying or repeatedly making incorrect essential entries on patient records.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing a fraudulent insurance act.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing a fraudulent insurance act, as defined in section 10-1-128

disciplinary_grounds.description: Refusing to complete or falsifying information on the renewal questionnaire.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Refusing to complete and submit the renewal questionnaire, or failing to report all of the relevant facts, or falsifying any information on the questionnaire as required pursuant to section 12-290-119

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to report to the board any podiatrist known to have violated provisions of the unprofessional conduct section.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to report to the board any podiatrist known to have violated or, upon information or belief, believed to have violated any of the provisions of this subsection (3)

disciplinary_grounds.description: Dividing fees or compensation or billing for services performed by an unlicensed person.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Dividing fees or compensation or billing for services performed by an unlicensed person as prohibited by section 12-290-122

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to report within 30 days any adverse action taken against the licensee by another licensing agency or body.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to report to the board within thirty days any adverse action taken against the licensee by another licensing agency in another state, territory, or country or any peer review body

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to report the surrender of a license or authorization to practice medicine in another jurisdiction while under investigation.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to report to the board the surrender of a license or other authorization to practice medicine in another state or jurisdiction or the surrender of membership on any medical staff or in any medical or professional association or society while under investigation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Discipline for acts related to the practice of podiatry in another state, territory, or country constitutes unprofessional conduct.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The discipline of a licensee for acts related to the practice of podiatry in another state, territory, or country shall be deemed unprofessional conduct.

insurance_required.quote: It is unlawful for any person to practice podiatry within the state of Colorado unless the person purchases and maintains professional liability insurance as follows: If the person performs surgical procedures, professional liability insurance shall be maintained in an amount not less than one million dollars per claim and three million dollars per year for all claims.

definition_quote.value: "Practice of podiatry" or "podiatric medicine" means: Holding out one's self to the public as being able to treat, prescribe for, palliate, correct, or prevent any disease, ailment, pain, injury, deformity, or physical condition of the human toe, foot, ankle, tendons that insert into the foot, and soft tissue below the mid-calf, by the use of any medical, surgical, mechanical, manipulative, or electrical treatment, including complications thereof consistent with the scope of practice
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of podiatry" or "podiatric medicine" means: Holding out one's self to the public as being able to treat, prescribe for, palliate, correct, or prevent any disease, ailment, pain, injury, deformity, or physical condition of the human toe, foot, ankle, tendons that insert into the foot, and soft tissue below the mid-calf, by the use of any medical, surgical, mechanical, manipulative, or electrical treatment, including complications thereof consistent with the scope of practice

methods_authorized.quote: by the use of any medical, surgical, mechanical, manipulative, or electrical treatment, including complications thereof consistent with the scope of practice

drug_authority.value: Podiatrists may prescribe drugs within the scope of podiatric medicine; subject to limitations on opioid prescribing and electronic prescribing of controlled substances.

amputation_authorized.quote: The "practice of podiatry" does not include the amputation of the foot

anesthesia_authority.quote: The "practice of podiatry" does not include the amputation of the foot or the administration of an anesthetic other than a local anesthetic.

ankle_surgery_authorized.quote: Surgical procedures on the ankle below the level of the dermis may be performed by a podiatrist licensed before July 1, 2010, in this state who: Is certified by the American Board of Podiatric Surgery or its successor organization

ankle_surgery_residency_requirement.quote: Has completed a three-year surgical residency approved by the board.

board_certification_body.quote: Is certified in reconstructive rearfoot/ankle surgery or foot and ankle surgery by the American Board of Podiatric Surgery or its successor organization

xray_technician_certification_required.quote: The board shall adopt rules prescribing minimum standards for the qualifications, education, and training of unlicensed persons operating machine sources of ionizing radiation and administering the radiation to patients for diagnostic podiatric use. Neither a podiatric physician nor a podiatrist shall allow any unlicensed person to operate a machine source of ionizing radiation or to administer radiation to any patient unless the person has met the standards then in effect under rules adopted pursuant to this section.
